review_description: He was the only person to attend our residence, and the only one to give a fully itemised  and costed quote.He used the best components in his quote, so it was not the cheapest but we felt very comfortable with his knowledge and service.

It is very annoying to receive a constant bombardment of offers from the "Supermarket style" solar companies. I highly value honesty and service. But above all both my husband and myself value politeness. We are prepared to pay more to ensure we receive the best services.
very hard to get good info on suppliers in the country
Most helpful in all stages. Installed without fuss and did not seek payment until all paperwork was completed and approved by the authorities and the system tirned on.
A little more communication from sales staff would have helped as we are out of town and contact was through email and phone, installation guy was more helpful especially for our tenant.

The whole job, including connection to the grid and approval was completed in one day. A qualified solar electrician was with the men. All paperwork was done for us. The personnel were most obliging, helpful and efficient. We would recommend this company happily.Questions about the quality are difficult to answer, but we believe we have had the best installed.
